limits: Detailed intermediate observations cover 12 real windows; u/Y and instance identities span all 589 reconstruction frames.
Reference pre inputs are independently regenerated by the original pre primitive from captured X and coefficients, then validated by exact replay of Y and the entire valid state.
Native output comparison is restricted to 48 valid subbands; local independent checks cover all 64.
Same-input real-source experiments use fixed R64/2^23 conversion, 48-band restriction and zero-state complete replay, not full object PCM scoring.
Reference coefficient quantization, energy clipping and epsilon-free ratios are runtime observations, not normative counterexamples.
Disabled/re-enabled native instances and non-default real ramp schedules were not added to native coverage.
